## Shared scenes

> [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) recalls the solemn vow she made to her sister [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) ten years ago never to marry. When [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) unexpectedly proposes to her, she finds herself unable to refuse him directly because she realizes she loves him, so she asks him for a few days to consider.
